{{Quote|We live in dangerous times. Where would you send them? Training rooms inside the Temple?|Master Benn, speaking to Matare about the problems Padawans faced on Tython|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Benn''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. He was one of the many [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who returned to [[Tython/Legends|Tython]], the Jedi [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]], to rebuild the Order at the conclusion of the [[Great Galactic War]] fought against the Sith Empire. While on the planet, Master Benn was frequently at the [[Masters' Retreat]], a [[Jedi Enclaves|Jedi Enclave]] located near the [[Jedi Temple (Tython)/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on Tython. Around the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3643 BBY]], a savage native [[Species/Legends|species]] known as the [[Flesh Raider]]s began to [[Flesh Raider uprising|attack]] Jedi and others in the [[Tythonian Gnarls|Gnarls]] and other regions near the Jedi Temple. Despite the dangers, Master Benn maintained that the Jedi [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] being taught on Tython should still be given [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] outside of the Temple's training rooms.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Our initiates must learn to recognize darkness&mdash;and danger.|Master Benn, speaking about Jedi Padawans on Tython|<ref name="TOR" />}}
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]], Benn was [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], a group of Force using individuals who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as peacekeepers. Eventually, Benn attained the rank of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]]. Following the [[Great Galactic War]] fought between the Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], Master Benn and many other [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] returned to the ancestral Jedi [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] to help rebuild the Order's losses in the war. During the Jedi Order's period of rebuilding, which occurred during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic, Master Benn stayed at the [[Masters' Retreat]], a [[Jedi Enclaves|Jedi Enclave]] near the [[Jedi Temple (Tython)/Legends|Jedi Temple]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].<ref name="TOR" /> Around the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="TORdate">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> an indigenous [[Species/Legends|species]] of violent savages known as the [[Flesh Raider]]s became increasingly hostile and began to [[Flesh Raider uprising|attack]] Jedi and other individuals in the vicinity of the Jedi Temple. During the hostilities with the Flesh Raiders, Master Benn spoke with a [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] Jedi named [[Matare (Zabrak)|Matare]] who believed that the region of Tython known as the [[Tythonian Gnarls|Gnarls]] had become too dangerous for Jedi [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] to train in. Master Benn convinced Matare that the Padawans needed to be taught to identify danger, but Matare still maintained that the Jedi could only afford a certain amount of losses.<ref name="TOR" />

==Personality and traits==
As evidenced by his conversation with Matare, Master Benn believed that Jedi Padawans training on Tython during the Flesh Raider attacks should not be secluded in the safety of the Jedi Temple's training rooms, but that they should allow them the opportunity to learn how to discern both darkness and dangerous situations. Master Benn was sensitive to the Force like all other Jedi. He had [[Color/Legends|blue-gray]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], light brown [[Hair/Legends|hair]], and fair skin. While on Tython, Master Benn wore brown colored [[Jedi apparel/Legends|robes]] and carried a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], the traditional weapon of the Jedi Order.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Master Benn first appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[2011]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online roleplaying game|MMORPG]] produced by [[BioWare]]. In the game, Benn appears as a character on the planet Tython in the Masters' Retreat, the starting area for players that choose the Jedi Knight or Jedi Consular class. In the game, Benn has a conversation with a Jedi named Matare, which the player can observe and hear, but not be a part of. The conversation includes a line of dialogue where Matare called Benn "Master," but Matare is the same level and wears the same clothes as Benn. In any event, the game does not specify whether Benn was Matare's Jedi Master.<ref name="TOR" />
